Name: NPC Adventures - June (Pre 2.3 Ridgeside)
Author: thelovelygamergirl
Description:
Wow, my first mod for Stardew ever! I recently downloaded [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4582]NPC Adventures[/url] and was a little disappointed when I saw I couldn't recruit [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10100]Custom NPC June[/url] by ch20youk/moetrash to go on adventures with me. So I quickly taught myself how to put a custom package together to make it happen!

I tried to keep as close to June's personality as I could in his dialogue. Though I will say if you become his spouse, some of the lines are a little thirsty/suggestive (you are married after all!). June has some ambient dialogue that he says as you travel with him throughout Stardew including Ridgeside Village!

Since June is well traveled and originally from Zuzu City he is able to defend himself, thus he is a Fighter. He gives +2 luck and +1 attack as buffs. This can be modified in the Buffs.json if you would like to change it.

To use this mod, just unzip it in your Mod folder.
